latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of jimeng-image skill for automated Jimeng image generation.

- Supports full Jimeng image creation flow via OpenClaw-managed browser.
- Allows prompt entry, aspect ratio selection, and generation option adjustments.
- Handles login gates, approvals, payment requirements, and credit exhaustion.
- Downloads generated images locally and reports file paths to the user.
- Provides clear guidance and failure reporting for common scenarios.
